summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of Akasha MVP Slice 2 (Phase 2 raster de-risk). All 13 backend API endpoints tested successfully. The raster tile and statistics endpoints correctly return HTTP 503 with RASTER_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE (expected behavior in this environment without MinIO/TiTiler/COGs). All error responses follow the standard shape. Slice 0 endpoints remain functional (regression passed).
passed_tests: GET /api/config returns 200 with supportedIndices=['NDVI','NDRE','NDMI','NDWI_GREEN_NIR'], defaultIndex='NDVI', maxPolygonAreaHa=50, aoi.id='bangalore'
GET /api/sources returns 200 with sentinel-2-l2a source and supportedIndices
GET /api/sources/UNKNOWN/dates returns 404 with error.code='NO_ITEMS' and standard error shape
POST /api/indices/statistics with Point geometry returns 422 with error.code='INVALID_GEOMETRY'
POST /api/indices/statistics with unsupported indexType='NOPE' returns 400 with error.code='UNSUPPORTED_INDEX'
POST /api/indices/statistics with oversized polygon returns 413 with error.code='POLYGON_TOO_LARGE'
POST /api/indices/statistics with valid polygon returns 503 with error.code='RASTER_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE' (EXPECTED - MinIO/COGs absent)
GET /api/tiles/sentinel-2-l2a/2025-09-14/rgb/12/2937/1881.png returns 503 with error.code='RASTER_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE' (EXPECTED - TiTiler absent)
All error responses follow standard shape: {"error": {"code": ..., "message": ..., "details": ...}}
